records.technical_object: Conductor in a static external electric field: induced spatial charge redistribution vs net acquired charge; electromagnetic induction and electrostatic polarization are not synonyms.

source.title: OpenStax University Physics Vol 2 §5.2, Figs 5.10–5.13
source.method: OpenStax university text HTML reopened in pilot 2026-11-23, not an ANRE scoring key, licensing requires separate check before offline redistribution
source.preceding_context: Figure 5.10: a neutral conductor polarizes under an external electric field, remaining electrically neutral overall.
source.central_paraphrase: Figs 5.12–5.13: induction creates separated net charges only with a further separation of conductors or grounding/disconnection sequence; simply putting isolated conductor in external field changes distribution.
source.following_context: Figure 5.13 illustrates grounding and subsequent removal of connection and inducing rod; distinguishes redistribution from net charging
source.scope_limit: Electrostatic source does not validate original electromagnetic-induction wording and does not make unspecified net charging unconditional.

ABC.ORIGINAL_A: Conduction typically presupposes contact/transfer, not merely presence in E
ABC.ORIGINAL_B: Wrong physical term for static electric-field-induced polarization; NOT certifiable from this source
ABC.ORIGINAL_C: Magnetization concerns magnetic response, not static electrostatic charge redistribution
ABC.TRAINER_A: Conduction/contact not mechanism specified by field-only stem
ABC.TRAINER_B: Electrostatic induction describes charge separation; net charge acquired NOT implied without additional step

records.source_corrected_option: B in Trainer ONLY with polarization definition, NOT source original
records.needs_owner: Decide if the original ANRE-style wording stays flagged as technically unanswerable while corrected unofficial Trainer variant is taught with net-charge caveat. Never change imported B silently.

records.technical_object: Exact I7 bell transformer/bell 220V power source allowance: lighting circuit OR socket circuit OR panel, not exclusive to one path.

source.title: Portalul Legislativ official I7/2011 technical regulation, consolidated document, point 5.4.13
source.method: Official government portal document HTML reopened 2026-11-23 using web scrape; version/bibliographic scope for ANRE 2026 exam not independently signed
source.preceding_context: §5.4.12 concerns avoiding routing unrelated circuits across specified environmental-class rooms and exceptions for kitchens/bathrooms with protective measures
source.exact_central_clause: 5.4.13 Alimentarea transformatorului de sonerie sau soneriei de 220 V se face dintr-un circuit de iluminat normal, dintr-un circuit de prize sau direct din tabloul de distribuție.
source.following_context: §5.4.14 concerns multiple circuits in a common tube or gutter and cross-references §5.2.12
source.scope_limit: Exact bell power feed matches stem except 220→230 nominal notation; official-scored ANRE original answer key is NOT authenticated.

ABC.ORIGINAL_B: FALSE_EXCLUSIVITY: only from lighting excludes panel/socket allowed by I7

records.technical_object: Earth main terminal/bar at general board: individual disconnectability and tool-only disconnection, not accessible toolless removal.

source.title: Portalul Legislativ official I7/2011 technical regulation, section 5.5.2.3
source.method: Official government HTML reopened in current pilot 2026-11-23; exact legal page returned; 2026 official grade-specific exam scoring key/bibliography unverified
source.preceding_context: §5.5.2.1 lists conductors for main earth bar (PEN, PE, N under relevant supply systems, equipotential and earth connections); §5.5.2.2 clarifies conductors connected indirectly through a main protection conductor
source.exact_central_clause: 5.5.2.3 Fiecare conductor conectat la bornă /bara principală de legare la pământ trebuie să poată fi deconectat individual. Această conectare trebuie să fie sigură și deconectabilă numai prin intermediul unei scule.
source.following_context: §5.5.3.1 lists possible forms of protective conductor PE, including insulated/uninsulated, cable and metal equipment parts with conditions
source.scope_limit: Statement covers conductors actually connected at main earth bar; Trainer option C remains true but incomplete subset of B.
